messages:
ida: FYI during a dashboard spike I saw requests attributed to unrelated projects. digging shows auth routing used token.project for pool selection but quota calc later used origin header.
raj: that mismatch will cause both false 403s and surprise billing. where are the two code paths diverging?
carmen: pre-routing logic lives in `proxy/router.go` and quota uses `usage/attribution.go`. both call separate resolvers.
ida: proposal: introduce single `AttributionResolver` in auth-common and the router + quota code must call it. resolver returns {project, reason}.
raj: agree. also add immutable decision attached to request context so downstream systems and logs all see same value.
carmen: telemetry: emit `attribution.decision` counter with reason tags like `HEADER_VERIFIED|HEADER_REJECTED|DELEGATION|TOKEN`. support-bot: noted: make dashboard tile for top reasons.
ida: security: don't accept X-Origin-Project unless signature verified or token has `allow_origin_override`. add `origin_override_attempt` log when header ignored.
raj: UX: Console -> Request inspector should show "Attribution: proj-123 (HEADER_VERIFIED)" and a small history link. support folks asked for direct link to raw headers.
carmen: rollout: implement resolver + tests, behind feature flag `auth.unified_attribution`. Canary to staging then small % prod. include alert if mismatch rate not zero during canary.
ida: i'll draft PR and tests. raj, can you own console change?
raj: yep. small note: ensure resolver is deterministic when delegation chain present: pick first non-null impersonator.
carmen: deploy-bot: queued image build auth-proxy:v2.15.0-unified-attrib-canary.
ida: thanks. we'll coordinate release notes and runbook update so oncall knows about new `attribution.decision` field.
thread_summary: Short thread agreeing to unify project attribution resolution into a single resolver (auth-common), add telemetry and console UI, enforce signature/allowlist checks, and rollout behind a feature flag.
